summary: Under Pressure: Half Butterfly Mastery covers positioning, entries and upper- and lower-body attacks with Brian Glick.
description: A half-butterfly course spanning inside position, sweeps, kimuras and leg entanglements.
overview: Brian Glick builds Under Pressure: Half Butterfly Mastery around reaching and attacking from half butterfly. Positioning and entries lead into sumi gaeshi, shoulder-crunch and kimura material, followed by near- and far-leg entanglements. A fourth volume condenses the main material into an executive summary.

fits: You want half butterfly as an attacking guard, including both sweeping and leg-entry options.

includes: Inside and head position; entries from closed guard, seated butterfly, reverse De La Riva and pinned positions.
Sumi gaeshi, shoulder crunch and kimura; near- and far-leg ashi entries and troubleshooting.
limits: The attacks center on half butterfly. The entries from other positions do not make this a general seated-guard or pin-escape course.
